description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Cloudshift and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
